parsed.summary: The change introduces a potential fix for the inconsistent behavior of `world_to_pixel` in `SlicedLowLevelWCS`, but it may not be minimal or clear.

issues.description: The change introduces additional logic that may not be necessary or clear. It appends sliced-out world coordinates to the world arrays, which could be a non-minimal approach to solving the issue.
The code could benefit from additional comments to explain the purpose of the new logic and why it is necessary.
